svg.desc: Decode + release: protobuf-java 623, TruffleData generated 663, TruffleData slab 311, TruffleData session 620. Decode + read every field + release: protobuf-java 669, TruffleData generated 690, TruffleData slab 531, TruffleData session 864. Java heap per decode: protobuf-java 1,630, TruffleData generated 1,608, TruffleData slab 808, TruffleData session 40.0. Large message · decode + release: protobuf-java 179, TruffleData generated 200, TruffleData slab 75.2, TruffleData session 167. Guest reads · interpreter: protobuf-java* 45.1, protobuf-java via interop 1,393, TruffleData generated 167, TruffleData slab 168. svg.text: The same binary messages through protobuf-java and TruffleData, decoded and read from guest code.
bytes allocated / message · lower is better
ns / message (warm, peak tier) · lower is better
Bars: median of three fresh processes; whiskers: min–max of the three, not confidence intervals.
* Direct protobuf-java getters run ahead-of-time behind one Truffle boundary per message; “via interop” exposes the same objects to guest code. The session decodes into a scoped native arena
outside the Java heap, so its heap chip compares the owning slab instead; generated messages own their data.
One quiet host (AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9965WX 24-Cores), every shard in sequence on one pinned CPU · Linux x86-64 · GraalVM Native Image · O2 · serial GC · no PGO.
TruffleData 0.12.0 (c378d6d) · measured 2026-11-12 · image sha256 5f2609c43f40 · hashes in manifest.json
